2609.15638.title: Potential of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Identification of Relevant Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarkers of Early-Stage Liver Cancer
2609.15638.paper_summary: This study explores the use of deep learning and explainable artificial intelligence to diagnose hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and define effective biomarkers across five different stages of disease development using a transcriptomic biomarker HCC dataset constructed via semi-supervised learning from three source datasets. Several deep learning experiments were conducted with different feature extraction techniques and gene sets to identify the most effective features for training high-accuracy models with minimal loss. The best-performing model, using 15 selected genes with the SelectKBest algorithm, achieved 90.74% accuracy, while the model with the lowest recorded loss of 0.3187 was obtained using 20 selected genes. To address the issue of class imbalance in the dataset, a weighted training approach was conducted, and for model transparency and interpretability a SHAP-based XAI analysis provided insights into the model's decision-making, consistently finding DNAJB14 as the most influential gene. Functional validation in this study has provided compelling evidence that DNAJB14 plays an important role in the adverse properties of HCC and that its inhibition effectively reverses tumour cell migration, invasion, colony and sphere formation. The main limitation of this study is the dataset's class imbalance, and while weighted training helped mitigate this, further research and additional data are needed to guarantee model generalizability. Future studies should also explore the influence of genetic variations, environmental factors, and clinical differences on model performance across diverse populations.
2609.15638.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究探討了使用深度學習和可解釋的人工智慧來診斷肝細胞癌（HCC），並定義在五個不同疾病發展階段的有效生物標記，使用通過半監督學習從三個來源數據集中構建的轉錄組生物標記HCC數據集。進行了幾個深度學習實驗，使用不同的特徵提取技術和基因集，以識別訓練高準確度模型所需的最有效特徵，並將損失降至最低。表現最佳的模型使用了15個選定基因，通過SelectKBest算法達到了90.74%的準確率，而損失最低的模型為0.3187，使用了20個選定基因。為了解決數據集中類別不平衡的問題，採用了加權訓練方法，並且為了模型的透明性和可解釋性，基於SHAP的XAI分析提供了對模型決策過程的見解，持續發現DNAJB14是最具影響力的基因。本研究中的功能驗證提供了有力的證據，顯示DNAJB14在HCC的不良特性中扮演著重要角色，並且其抑制有效地逆轉了腫瘤細胞的遷移、侵襲、集落和球體形成。本研究的主要限制是數據集的類別不平衡，雖然加權訓練有助於減輕這一問題，但仍需進一步研究和額外數據以保證模型的通用性。未來的研究還應探索基因變異、環境因素和臨床差異對不同人群模型性能的影響。
